headline: Gold, Silver, and Crude Oil Fall as Federal Reserve Rate Hike Fears Weigh on Markets
summary: Precious metals and crude oil dropped sharply, with gold falling nearly 2.45 percent on COMEX and over 2.9 percent on the MCX, pressured by fears of potential Federal Reserve rate hikes.
why: Expectations of tighter US monetary policy strengthen the US dollar and raise borrowing costs, typically weighing on dollar-denominated commodities.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Fears of higher US interest rates reduce investor demand for non-yielding bullion assets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Anticipation of Federal Reserve interest rate hikes drove broad selling across gold, silver, and crude oil markets.
